job_location: Thanh Xuan Bac Ward, Hanoi, Vietnam
responsibilities: Work closely with relevant business functions to understand the domain and data structure
Contribute to the solution of various data migration, data modeling, data validation and governance

Coordinate with stakeholders to understand the data requirements such as user insights, customer journeys, business metrics; translating business requests to meaningful data implementation; perform corresponding analysis to develop datasets, reports, and dashboards using BI tools
Analyze data for trends and patterns to support business strategic planning
Collaborate with data engineers to develop efficient frameworks and tools for data quality and data lineage
Coach business users to get familiar with BI reports
Perform data audit to identify the cause of mismatched data between systems when needed

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Collaborate with data engineers to develop efficient frameworks and tools for data quality and data lineage
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Validation, governance, quality, lineage and audit appear across the responsibilities; "fast-growth environment" is the only speed phrase and it sits in the perks section.
evidence.domain_risk: Be part of a mission-driven fintech company that is transforming financial access for millions of Vietnamese underserved
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A consumer lending fintech with credit scoring in scope — errors reach financial decisions about borrowers at scale.
evidence.collaboration_width: data engineers; business users; junior data analysts
evidence.data_team_maturity: Collaborate with data engineers to develop efficient frameworks and tools for data quality and data lineage
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Separate data engineers and junior data analysts already exist and a warehouse is in place, but there are no named sub-teams or scale signals.
